US TV Anchor Fired After Viral Newsroom Profanity Amid Lawsuit

Former Detroit TV anchor Taryn Asher was captured on video using profanity against her boss during a newsroom dispute. The incident occurred as Asher is suing Fox Television Stations over her termination. The station, however, states that Asher was dismissed due to alleged unprofessional conduct.
